metadata.title: About Us | IT Solutions Company in India | Cloute Technologies
metadata.description: Cloute Technologies Pvt Ltd is a leading IT Solutions Company in India specializing in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and innovative tech solutions.

purpose.i0_text: To be a global leader in IT and cybersecurity, driving innovation and delivering seamless, secure, and scalable solutions worldwide. We aim to shape the future of digital transformation, empowering organizations to thrive in a connected world.
purpose.i1_text: Empowering businesses with cutting-edge technology, offering comprehensive IT and security solutions that drive efficiency, reduce risks, and enable sustainable growth. We are the catalyst that propels our clients to new heights of digital success, ensuring they remain competitive and secure in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

offerings.i0_text: We design and implement scalable network solutions that form the foundation of your IT operations, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and security across your entire digital ecosystem.
offerings.i1_text: Our expert developers create custom software solutions tailored to your unique business needs. From web applications to complex enterprise systems, we deliver high-quality, scalable software that drives efficiency.
offerings.i2_text: We provide secure, scalable cloud solutions that enable business agility and innovation, including migration and optimization to help you leverage the full potential of cloud technologies.
offerings.i3_text: Comprehensive managed IT services to keep your systems running smoothly — 24/7 monitoring, regular maintenance, and rapid issue resolution, allowing you to focus on your core business.
offerings.i4_text: Our advanced cybersecurity solutions protect your digital assets from evolving threats, employing state-of-the-art technologies and best practices to safeguard your data, networks, and systems against cyber attacks.

achievementDetails.i0_text: We've successfully completed over 1,000 global projects in IT and cybersecurity, ranging from small-scale implementations to large enterprise-wide transformations — each one further contributing to our expertise and expanding our global footprint.
achievementDetails.i1_text: With more than 500 satisfied clients served worldwide, we've built a reputation for reliability and excellence. Our client retention rate of 95% speaks volumes about the quality of our services and customer satisfaction.
achievementDetails.i2_text: Our team of 100+ cybersecurity experts ensures top-notch data security and privacy for our clients. With a combined experience of over 1,000 years, their expertise positions us as leaders in delivering comprehensive cybersecurity solutions.
achievementDetails.i3_text: Cloute Technologies has received numerous industry awards and certifications, including ISO 27001 for Information Security Management and being named a Gartner Cool Vendor in Cybersecurity.

leaders.i0_bio_i0: Govindraj Krishnamurthy, our CEO and Managing Director, is a globally recognized leader in the field of IT security with a distinguished career spanning over 25 years. His expertise and strategic vision have positioned him as a trailblazer in the cybersecurity domain, helping organizations navigate the ever-evolving landscape of digital threats.
leaders.i0_bio_i1: He is known for his ability to bridge the gap between technology and business, delivering solutions that align with organizational goals while ensuring optimal security.
leaders.i1_bio_i0: Dr. Suresh A Shan, our CIO, brings over 25 years of expertise in bridging industry and academia. He holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science and is certified in ITIL, PMP and Data Science, and is renowned for driving digital transformation and innovative solutions in emerging technologies like AI, Blockchain, Metaverse, and Cloud Computing.
leaders.i1_bio_i1: His accolades include pioneering geospatial initiatives, conducting 1,600+ academic leadership programs globally, and serving on 50+ advisory boards. At Cloute Technologies, he focuses on fostering innovation, enhancing digital trust, and delivering exceptional solutions to clients worldwide.
leaders.i2_bio_i0: Dr. Sampathkumaran is a distinguished scholar and practitioner in Materials Science and Engineering. He holds a doctoral degree from Mysore University and has over 35 years of experience at the Central Power Research Institute (CPRI), from which he retired as the Joint Director and Head of the Materials Technology Division.
leaders.i2_bio_i1: He has spearheaded numerous research projects and holds four patents, in addition to over 150 publications in peer-reviewed journals.
leaders.i3_bio_i0: Mr. Navin Kawal is an experienced leadership mentor and pharmaceutical industry professional with strong expertise in marketing strategy and business development. With a post-graduation in Science and an MBA from Mumbai University, he combines academic knowledge with extensive corporate experience. During his tenure at Sanofi India, he led Pan India Marketing & Sales operations and national-level Training and Development initiatives.
leaders.i3_bio_i1: He is certified by Dale Carnegie and Stephen Covey and has received multiple industry awards along with international exposure. He is also an active member of the Global Leadership Teams of Lions International, contributing to leadership and community development initiatives.
leaders.i4_bio_i0: Dr. Nagarajan Srinivasan is a distinguished technologist and thought leader with deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Network Security. With an Executive MTech in AI & ML and a PhD in Wireless Network Security, he combines cutting-edge academic knowledge with practical insights to address complex technological challenges.
leaders.i4_bio_i1: His career spans advanced research in computer science, where he earned an MPhil, and impactful contributions to the development of secure and intelligent systems. He is committed to leveraging AI-driven innovation to enhance network security and create scalable, robust solutions.
leaders.i5_bio_i0: Premkumar Gunasekaran is a seasoned Learning and Organizational Development (OD) Consultant with over two decades of experience in transforming individuals, teams, and organizations. His expertise lies in designing and delivering impactful L&D programs that enhance leadership capabilities, improve team dynamics, and foster organizational growth.
leaders.i5_bio_i1: He has been instrumental in driving workforce transformation across IT, ITES, Retail, BPO, and Staffing sectors, and develops sustainable learning solutions tailored to meet specific business needs.
leaders.i6_bio_i0: Anand Pattanshettar is the Founder and CEO of SecuCybers and a cybersecurity leader with over 17 years of experience in enterprise security solutions. He helps organizations identify and manage cybersecurity risks, enabling business leaders to make informed strategic decisions.
leaders.i6_bio_i1: Previously, he worked with Intel Security (McAfee), Wipro, and FSIT, leading cybersecurity consulting teams and enterprise security projects. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, an MBA, and multiple industry security certifications, focusing on scalable and business-driven cybersecurity programs.
